title: Edit plan
description: The interface between bot/ (produces) and render/ (consumes). A plan is one source file, one output spec, and an ordered list of clips. Each clip is a keep-list of time segments from the source, concatenated in order. v1.1 adds an optional reel: the renderer also concatenates every clip, with optional slide cards, into one summary video. Nothing else is implied: no effects, no transitions, no re-encoding choices beyond what output.* states.

version.description: Contract version. Renderer must reject any other value. v1.1 fields are all optional, so v1 plans stay valid.

path.description: Path to the source video, relative to the repo root or absolute. Forward slashes only; the renderer normalizes for the OS.

duration_seconds.description: Optional. If present the renderer must reject any segment whose end exceeds it.

kind.description: Where captions come from. embedded = subtitle stream in the source (e.g. Meet mov_text). srt = sidecar file at `path`. none = no captions available.

dir.description: Directory the renderer writes into. Created if missing. Files are named <clip.id>.<container>.

preset.description: Destination preset. Sets defaults for aspect and encoding; explicit fields on output override the preset. See bot/research/clip-guidelines.md.

aspect.description: Output frame. 16:9 keeps the source frame. 9:16 and 1:1 center-crop unless a clip sets crop_focus.

captions.description: burn_in renders captions into the pixels. sidecar_srt writes <clip.id>.srt next to the video. Ignored when source.captions.kind = none.

reel.description: v1.1. When present, the renderer ALSO writes one concatenated summary video: [intro] + for each clip in order ([card] + clip) + [outro]. Every segment is normalized to one size, frame rate and audio layout; cards carry silence so audio is continuous. Individual clip files are still written exactly as in v1.

intro.description: Optional slide before the first clip.

outro.description: Optional slide after the last clip.

chapter_cards.description: auto = a card before a clip only when that clip carries its own `card`. all = every clip gets a card, synthesized from clip.takeaway when it has none. none = never.

summary.description: Optional companion document (executive summary + transcript). Produced by bot/, written here so render/ can copy it into output.dir. See veb-t2b.6.

end.description: Seconds from source start, exclusive. Must be > start.

card.description: v1.1. A full-frame slide: dark background, a title, up to four lines of text, shown for `seconds` with silent audio. The renderer draws it; no image files are exchanged.

id.description: Output file stem. Unique within the plan.

takeaway.description: One sentence: the single idea this clip lands. Used for the title card / filename metadata / summary.

segments.description: Keep-list. Rendered in array order and concatenated. Segments may be non-contiguous and out of source order. Total kept duration should stay within the preset's length bounds; the renderer warns but does not reject.

hook_offset_seconds.description: Offset within the concatenated clip where the payoff sentence starts. Informational for the renderer (title-card timing); the bot should already have ordered segments so this is 0.

trim_silence.description: Renderer may tighten leading/trailing silence at segment boundaries by up to 0.5 s. Never removes speech.

crop_focus.description: Only used when output.aspect is not 16:9. speaker = renderer's best effort; falls back to center.

card.description: v1.1. Optional explainer slide shown immediately before this clip in the reel (only used when output.reel is present).
